# Isolde Pembroke

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 at the start of volume 1 [v01:c02:p0062], turning 12 in February [v01:c12:p0040], and turning 13 the following February [v01:c26:p0004].  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061), [v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062)</sub>
- **Origin:** Pear Hill, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Isolde is an extremely attractive girl with rosy cheeks, black hair, and dark eyes inherited from her mother. Her cheerful expression is a legacy from her father. She considers her figure to be plump and like a dumpling.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c33 P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013)_

## Personality

Isolde is cheerful, good-natured, intelligent, and prone to bursting into laughter before speaking. She loves reading books to the point of straining her eyes. Though easily influenced by her strict mother's rules, she remains deeply loyal, romantic, and affectionate toward her close friends.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 c21 P19](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0019)_

## History

Isolde Pembroke returns home to Pear Hill after visiting her aunt in Delford and soon meets Nell Harcourt, who visits with Thirza Abernethy. The two girls quickly become bosom friends, swearing a solemn vow over a pretend stream to remain loyal friends forever. Together they share books, play around Pear Hill and the surrounding woods, and create a playhouse named Larkrise. After consuming three glassfuls of home-brewed cordial at Grey Shutters, Isolde becomes dizzy, giggles, falls asleep, and develops a severe headache. Her mother assumes Nell deliberately got Isolde drunk and forbids Isolde from playing or speaking with Nell. Isolde secretly meets Nell near the Nymph's Well to bid her a tearful farewell, giving her a lock of her hair, and later sends her a note and a tissue-paper bookmark at school. After Nell saves Isolde's younger sister Posy Fay from croup, Mrs. Pembroke realizes her mistake and restores their friendship. Isolde attends a concert with Nell and hosts her great-aunt Lavinia Pembroke, who funds Isolde's music lessons after Nell intercedes on her behalf. Over the years, Isolde and Nell attend Brierley school together, craft stories for a writing club, and travel to town for a fair with her father and Miss Lavinia Pembroke. When Nell attends Regent's class while Isolde does not, and later when Nell goes away to the Academy, the two remain loyal companions.

## Quotes

> The act of swearing is remarkably evil, after all  <sub>[v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030)</sub>

> Nell, you are an unusual girl. I had previously been told that you were unusual. Even so, it seems to me that I am going to be very fond of you.  <sub>[v1 c12 P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)</sub>

> It truly appears as though all things have come to a close, wouldn’t you say?  <sub>[v1 c32 P1](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0001)</sub>

> You have such a stylish quality, Nell. The way you carry your head gives you quite an air. My guess is it comes from your figure. Me, I am merely a dumpling.
